query syntax: term, "exact phrase", -exclude, target:geo, access:free|freemium|paid|api-key|free-registration, kind:map|feed|dataset|search|database|software|api|directory|reading|web-tool, region:AU, category:mapping, tag:bushfire, health:alive|bot-walled|dead, is:retired, has:description

Press / to focus search, Esc to clear. Filters and queries are written to the URL, so any view can be bookmarked or shared. This page is self-contained: the dataset and the search engine are embedded, and it works with no network connection.
